# formal_connector_token_encryption_key (Resource)

Register a KMS key encryption key (KEK) for HTTP policy token encryption on a Connector.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connector_id` (String) The ID of the Connector this token encryption key is linked to.
- `key_id` (String) Provider-native key identifier (AWS KMS ARN, GCP CryptoKey resource name, or Azure Key Vault key URI).
- `key_provider` (String) The KMS provider. One of 'aws-kms', 'gcp-kms', or 'azure-key-vault'.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the connector token encryption key was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this connector token encryption key.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time.
